abandon.en: The hikers had to abandon their plan because of the sudden storm.
abandon.zh: 登山客因為突如其來的暴風雨，只好放棄原本的計畫。

abbreviate.en: To save space, the editor abbreviated several common expressions in the chart.
abbreviate.zh: 為了節省空間，編輯把圖表中的幾個常用詞組縮寫了。

ability.en: She has the ability to explain difficult ideas clearly.
ability.zh: 她有能力把困難的概念解釋得很清楚。

abolish.en: The government decided to abolish the outdated rule after years of public debate.
abolish.zh: 經過多年的公共討論後，政府決定廢除這項過時的規定。

absence.en: Her repeated absence from class made it difficult for her to keep up with the lessons.
absence.zh: 她一再缺課，使她很難跟上課程進度。

absorb.en: Plants absorb water through their roots and use it to grow.
absorb.zh: 植物透過根部吸收水分，並利用水分生長。

abstract.en: Some abstract ideas become easier to understand when they are explained with examples.
abstract.zh: 有些抽象概念在搭配例子說明後會比較容易理解。

abundant.en: Fresh water is abundant in some regions but extremely limited in others.
abundant.zh: 淡水在某些地區很充足，但在其他地區卻極為有限。

abuse.en: The new policy was designed to prevent the abuse of personal information.
abuse.zh: 這項新政策是為了防止個人資料遭到濫用。

academic.en: The school provides extra academic support before major exams.
academic.zh: 學校會在大型考試前提供額外的學業輔導。

accelerate.en: New technology may accelerate the spread of information across the world.
accelerate.zh: 新科技可能會加速資訊在全球傳播的速度。

accept.en: Learning to accept different opinions is an important part of teamwork.
accept.zh: 學會接受不同的意見，是團隊合作中很重要的一部分。

access.en: Students can access the digital library from home with their school accounts.
access.zh: 學生可以使用學校帳號從家中存取數位圖書館。

accompany.en: A teacher will accompany the students on their visit to the science museum.
accompany.zh: 一位老師會陪同學生參觀科學博物館。

accomplish.en: The team worked together to accomplish a task that seemed impossible at first.
accomplish.zh: 這個團隊共同合作，完成了一項起初看似不可能的任務。

accumulate.en: Small amounts of plastic can accumulate in the ocean over many years.
accumulate.zh: 少量的塑膠經過多年可能會逐漸累積在海洋中。

accurate.en: Accurate information is essential when you write a research report.
accurate.zh: 撰寫研究報告時，準確的資訊非常重要。

accuse.en: It is unfair to accuse someone without enough evidence.
accuse.zh: 在沒有足夠證據的情況下指控別人是不公平的。

achieve.en: With steady practice, you can achieve your academic goals.
achieve.zh: 只要持續練習，你就能達成學業上的目標。

acknowledge.en: The writer acknowledged that the first explanation was incomplete.
acknowledge.zh: 作者承認第一個解釋並不完整。

adjust.en: It may take a few weeks to adjust to a new study schedule.
adjust.zh: 適應新的讀書作息可能需要幾個星期。

advantage.en: One advantage of studying in a group is that students can exchange ideas.
advantage.zh: 小組學習的一個優點是學生可以交換想法。

affect.en: Lack of sleep can affect your concentration in class.
affect.zh: 睡眠不足會影響你在課堂上的專注力。

alternative.en: Walking or cycling can be a healthy alternative to taking a car.
alternative.zh: 步行或騎腳踏車可以是開車之外的健康替代方式。

amount.en: The amount of water we use each day can be reduced through simple habits.
amount.zh: 透過簡單的習慣，我們可以減少每天的用水量。

analyze.en: Students were asked to analyze the causes of the problem.
analyze.zh: 學生被要求分析這個問題發生的原因。

annual.en: The school holds an annual science fair every spring.
annual.zh: 學校每年春天都會舉辦科學展覽。

approach.en: We need a different approach to solve this complicated problem.
approach.zh: 我們需要用不同的方法來解決這個複雜的問題。

appropriate.en: Choose language that is appropriate for both your audience and purpose.
appropriate.zh: 請選擇適合你的讀者與寫作目的的語言。

assume.en: Do not assume that every source on the Internet is reliable.
assume.zh: 不要以為網路上的每個資訊來源都可靠。

attitude.en: A positive attitude can make difficult tasks feel more manageable.
attitude.zh: 正面的態度可以讓困難的任務感覺比較容易處理。

available.en: The new learning materials are available online for free.
available.zh: 新的學習教材可以在網路上免費取得。

behavior.en: The study examined how online feedback influences student behavior.
behavior.zh: 這項研究探討網路回饋如何影響學生行為。

benefit.en: Regular exercise can benefit both your body and your mind.
benefit.zh: 規律運動對身體與心理都有好處。

challenge.en: Learning to manage your time is a common challenge for high school students.
challenge.zh: 學會管理時間，是高中生常見的挑戰。

circumstance.en: Under these circumstances, delaying the trip was the safest choice.
circumstance.zh: 在這些情況下，延後旅行是最安全的選擇。

community.en: Local volunteers worked together to improve the safety of their community.
community.zh: 當地志工共同合作，改善社區的安全。

concept.en: The teacher used a diagram to explain the difficult concept clearly.
concept.zh: 老師用圖表清楚說明這個困難的概念。

condition.en: The plants grew faster when they were kept under the same condition.
condition.zh: 這些植物在相同條件下生長得更快。

consequence.en: Every decision may have a consequence that we did not expect.
consequence.zh: 每個決定都可能帶來我們沒有預料到的後果。

consider.en: You should consider several factors before making a final decision.
consider.zh: 做最後決定前，你應該考慮幾項因素。

context.en: The meaning of an unfamiliar word can often be guessed from its context.
context.zh: 陌生單字的意思常常可以從上下文推測。

contrast.en: In contrast to the first plan, the new proposal costs much less.
contrast.zh: 與第一個方案相比，新提案的成本低很多。

contribute.en: Small daily habits can contribute to long-term success.
contribute.zh: 每天的小習慣可以促成長期的成功。

decision.en: She considered several options carefully before making her final decision.
decision.zh: 她在做最後決定前仔細考慮了幾個選項。

define.en: The report clearly defines the problem before suggesting possible solutions.
define.zh: 這份報告在提出可能的解決方法前先清楚定義問題。

demonstrate.en: The experiment demonstrates how temperature can affect the speed of a reaction.
demonstrate.zh: 這項實驗示範溫度如何影響反應速度。

develop.en: Reading widely can help students develop stronger critical-thinking skills.
develop.zh: 廣泛閱讀能幫助學生培養更好的批判思考能力。

distribution.en: The map shows the distribution of rainfall across different regions.
distribution.zh: 這張地圖顯示不同地區的降雨分布。

economic.en: The city hopes the new railway will bring long-term economic benefits.
economic.zh: 這座城市希望新鐵路能帶來長期的經濟效益。

environment.en: A quiet environment can make it easier to concentrate on studying.
environment.zh: 安靜的環境能讓人更容易專心讀書。

establish.en: The school plans to establish a new program for student volunteers.
establish.zh: 學校計畫成立一個新的學生志工計畫。

estimate.en: Experts estimate that the project will take about two years to complete.
estimate.zh: 專家估計這項計畫大約需要兩年才能完成。

evidence.en: The scientist collected more evidence before drawing a conclusion.
evidence.zh: 科學家在下結論前蒐集了更多證據。

experience.en: Working on the project gave him valuable experience in solving real problems.
experience.zh: 參與這項計畫讓他獲得解決真實問題的寶貴經驗。

factor.en: Cost is only one factor to consider when choosing a school.
factor.zh: 費用只是選擇學校時要考慮的其中一項因素。

feature.en: One useful feature of the app is its offline study mode.
feature.zh: 這個應用程式的一項實用功能是離線學習模式。

function.en: The diagram explains the function of each part of the machine.
function.zh: 這張圖說明機器各部分的功能。

identify.en: The first step is to identify the main cause of the problem.
identify.zh: 第一步是找出問題的主要原因。

impact.en: Social media can have a strong impact on the way people communicate.
impact.zh: 社群媒體會對人們溝通的方式產生很大的影響。

indicate.en: The results indicate that regular review improves long-term memory.
indicate.zh: 結果顯示，規律複習能提升長期記憶。

individual.en: Each individual may respond to the same situation differently.
individual.zh: 每個人面對相同情況時，反應可能都不一樣。

information.en: The website provides useful information about scholarships and application deadlines.
information.zh: 這個網站提供有關獎學金與申請截止日期的實用資訊。

involve.en: The project will involve students from several different classes.
involve.zh: 這項計畫將會有好幾個不同班級的學生參與。

issue.en: The class discussed the issue from several different points of view.
issue.zh: 全班從幾個不同的角度討論這項議題。

likely.en: Students are more likely to remember information when they review it regularly.
likely.zh: 學生規律複習時，更有可能記住所學資訊。

maintain.en: It is easier to maintain a study habit when your daily goal is realistic.
maintain.zh: 每天的目標訂得實際，比較容易維持讀書習慣。

major.en: Traffic is a major source of air pollution in many large cities.
major.zh: 交通是許多大城市空氣污染的主要來源。

measure.en: Researchers used a simple test to measure changes in attention.
measure.zh: 研究人員使用簡單測驗來測量注意力的變化。

method.en: The teacher introduced a simple method for remembering difficult vocabulary.
method.zh: 老師介紹了一個記住困難單字的簡單方法。

occur.en: Most accidents occur when people stop paying attention to their surroundings.
occur.zh: 大多數意外都發生在人們不再注意周遭環境的時候。

participate.en: Students are encouraged to participate actively in class discussions.
participate.zh: 老師鼓勵學生主動參與課堂討論。

potential.en: The new material has the potential to reduce energy use in buildings.
potential.zh: 這種新材料有潛力降低建築物的能源使用。

principle.en: The design follows the basic principle that simple systems are easier to maintain.
principle.zh: 這項設計遵循一個基本原則：簡單的系統比較容易維護。

process.en: Learning a language is a gradual process that requires regular practice.
process.zh: 學習語言是一個需要規律練習的漸進過程。

provide.en: The chart provides useful information about changes over time.
provide.zh: 這張圖表提供了有關長期變化的實用資訊。

reason.en: There is a good reason to check the source before sharing information online.
reason.zh: 在網路上分享資訊前先確認來源是有充分理由的。

relationship.en: Trust plays an important role in building a healthy relationship.
relationship.zh: 信任在建立健康關係中扮演重要角色。

require.en: This task requires careful reading and logical thinking.
require.zh: 這項任務需要仔細閱讀與邏輯思考。

research.en: The students conducted research on how sleep affects learning and memory.
research.zh: 學生研究睡眠如何影響學習與記憶。

resource.en: The school website offers many useful resources for exam preparation.
resource.zh: 學校網站提供許多準備考試的實用資源。

response.en: Her response showed that she had understood the main point of the question.
response.zh: 她的回答顯示她已理解題目的重點。

responsibility.en: Students should take responsibility for completing their work on time.
responsibility.zh: 學生應對按時完成自己的作業負責。

result.en: The experiment produced a surprising result that no one had expected.
result.zh: 這項實驗產生了沒有人預料到的驚人結果。

role.en: Parents can play an important role in helping teenagers build healthy habits.
role.zh: 家長可以在幫助青少年建立健康習慣方面扮演重要角色。

section.en: Read the final section of the article before answering the questions.
section.zh: 回答問題前請先閱讀文章的最後一節。

significant.en: There was a significant improvement in her reading speed after months of practice.
significant.zh: 經過幾個月的練習後，她的閱讀速度有了明顯進步。

similar.en: The two solutions look similar, but they work in very different ways.
similar.zh: 這兩個解決方法看起來相似，但運作方式非常不同。

situation.en: In an emergency situation, staying calm can help you make better decisions.
situation.zh: 在緊急情況下保持冷靜，能幫助你做出更好的決定。

source.en: Always check whether the source of online information is reliable.
source.zh: 務必確認網路資訊的來源是否可靠。

specific.en: Give a specific example to support your main idea.
specific.zh: 請舉一個具體的例子來支持你的主要想法。

standard.en: The new safety standard requires all buildings to have clear emergency exits.
standard.zh: 新的安全標準要求所有建築物都有清楚的緊急出口。

strategy.en: She changed her study strategy after noticing which methods worked best.
strategy.zh: 她發現哪些方法最有效後，調整了自己的讀書策略。

structure.en: The structure of the essay makes its main argument easy to follow.
structure.zh: 這篇文章的結構讓主要論點很容易理解。

suggest.en: The data suggest that students learn better when they review regularly.
suggest.zh: 資料顯示，學生規律複習時學習效果比較好。

support.en: Use facts and examples to support your argument.
support.zh: 請用事實與例子來支持你的論點。

system.en: The new system allows students to review lessons on their phones.
system.zh: 新系統讓學生可以用手機複習課程。

technology.en: New technology has changed the way people communicate across long distances.
technology.zh: 新科技已改變人們進行遠距溝通的方式。

theory.en: The scientist tested the theory by comparing it with real-world data.
theory.zh: 科學家透過與真實世界資料比較來驗證這項理論。

therefore.en: The road was closed; therefore, we had to take another route.
therefore.zh: 道路封閉了，因此我們只好改走另一條路。

trend.en: The chart shows a clear trend toward increased use of renewable energy.
trend.zh: 圖表顯示再生能源使用量增加的明顯趨勢。

value.en: The survey helped the team understand the value of listening to users.
value.zh: 這項調查幫助團隊了解傾聽使用者意見的價值。

various.en: The library offers various resources for students preparing for exams.
various.zh: 圖書館提供各種資源給準備考試的學生。

vary.en: The amount of sleep people need can vary from person to person.
vary.zh: 每個人需要的睡眠時間可能有所不同。
